claws.body:
Legendary Burrowing Claws
Minimum level	35	
Item Type	Clothing / Gloves
Slot	Hand
Race Absolutely Required	None
Binding	Bound to Account on Acquire
Durability	450
Material	Leather
Hardness	55
Base Value	14,001pp 
Weight	0.10 lbs
Location	The Darklake, Depthdigger's chest
Enchantments	
Quality Armor-Piercing 5%
Seeker +15
Insightful Seeker +7
Nearly Complete: Ability Score
This item can be upgraded with one of the following:
Charisma +15
Constitution +15
Dexterity +15
Intelligence +15
Strength +15
Wisdom +15
Green Augment Slot
Colorless Augment Slot
Moon Augment Slot
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3
	
Upgradeable?	Nearly Complete
Description	Fashioned after the claws of the Bulette, these would be especially good for digging.
Tips
claws.exactWisdomTooltip: Wisdom +15: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

nearlyComplete.craftingRules: Which set of enchantments is available for an item depends on which version of the Nearly Complete enchantment the item has. For example, an item with Nearly Complete: Ability Score can be upgraded with an Enhancement bonus to one of the core stats. Upgrading an item with Nearly Completed requires 25 Abyssal Gems (or Legendary Abyssal Gems for Legendary items) from Terror of Demogorgon end chests. Note that you cannot replace a Nearly Completed upgrade after selecting one - you will need a new copy of the item to apply a different effect.

data.scope: Read-only mechanics check of replacing gear-Dexterity priority with Wisdom while preserving the selected INT longbow build. No solver jobs and no repository edits by this auditor.
data.access_limit: Parent observed a non-retryable robots.txt block for fresh DDO Wiki Spot access. No bypass was attempted. Retained direct Wiki receipts, retained source-ledger transcriptions, and independent publisher-authored sources were used. Historical release notes and manual are not an in-game test of every current interaction.

claims.claim: Spot and Listen are Wisdom-based skills. Ordinary Will saves use Wisdom. Heal is also Wisdom-based. No Wisdom-to-Will substitution feat is selected in the preserved guide chassis.
claims.limits: A different class-life or unreported feat such as Force of Personality/Liquid Courage could alter the operative Will ability; do not generalize this result to every possible character. Guide is selection evidence, not independent mechanics authority.

claims.claim: Use m(S)=floor((S-10)/2) on the total typed-and-stacked ability score. Adding Enhancement Wisdom15 yields a +15 whole-character Wisdom change only if no pre-existing overlapping Enhancement Wisdom source is already contributing. Under that no-overlap assumption, the modifier gain is +7 when the old total is even and +8 when it is odd. For otherwise unchanged ranks and direct bonuses, Spot, Listen and Wisdom-based Will change by the resulting modifier difference, not by the raw gear affix value.
claims.typed_stack_formula: If E is the pre-existing applicable Enhancement Wisdom bonus, delta_WIS=max(15,E)-E, with other bonus-type contributions unchanged; use that delta in the modifier formula.
claims.limits: No assumption is made about which buffs the user actually has. A pre-existing Enhancement Wisdom buff can reduce or eliminate the incremental benefit of the new item affix. The manual prints the paired-score modifier table through 24-25; the general floor expression is the standard algebraic expression of that progression. No live character total, full buffs, racial bonuses, or full past-life state was supplied. Do not infer either whole-score delta or parity from the gear-only subtotal. Direct Spot/Will bonuses from other item changes must be added separately.

claims.claim: The selected Harper Strategic Combat I/II provide INT for missile to-hit/damage. The selected Insightful Reflexes provides INT for Reflex; the original official feat text selects the higher INT/DEX modifier. Keeping INT and those selections preserves those INT-based contributions when INT is the operative higher modifier. Know the Angles remains INT-based. A gear DEX reduction itself does not increase DPS or critical range.
claims.limits: Conditional on the selected feats/enhancements actually being trained and INT remaining operative. This does not certify total rotation DPS, attack speed, crit profile or proc uptime. No Step Missed, the DEX-based trance, is explicitly not selected in this guide.

claims.claim: Removing gear DEX can lower the DEX ability-modifier contribution to Balance, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock and Tumble, and can lower the DEX contribution to Armor Class. A -15 whole-character DEX change is -8 modifier from an even old total or -7 from an odd old total, but this full loss assumes there is no other Enhancement DEX source replacing the removed Enhancement15 contribution. Purchased skill ranks do not change.
claims.typed_stack_formula: If E_D is the remaining applicable Enhancement Dexterity bonus, removing the Enhancement15 affix changes the total score by E_D-max(15,E_D); then recompute the modifier from the full typed stack.
claims.limits: Exact modifier and final AC loss require the full typed DEX stack, including overlapping nongear buffs, effective Maximum Dexterity Bonus and other AC rules. The raw DEX-derived AC term is constrained by armor MDB, so a raw -7/-8 ability modifier is not automatically -7/-8 final AC. Tumble charge rules keyed to trained ranks are not changed by lowering a gear ability score; no exact current charge/recharge model is certified here.

claims.claim: Dodge chance and Maximum Dexterity Bonus are separate quantities from the Dexterity ability score. The retained Dodge source caps Dodge by the applicable armor/shield MDB, not by the character's DEX modifier. Therefore switching only a DEX gear affix does not by itself lower the raw Dodge bonus or the item's MDB.
claims.limits: Do not equate an unchanged gear Dodge subtotal with certified live effective Dodge; the actual armor/build cap still applies. Armor itself is held unchanged in the controlled comparison.

claims.claim: Ability-score feat prerequisites count creation score, level-up ability points and inherent ability-tome bonuses. The retained Feats page explicitly excludes gear, enhancements, racial past-life bonuses, buffs and other listed non-inherent sources. A gear-only DEX-to-WIS swap leaves that feat-qualification ledger unchanged; it cannot substitute Wisdom for a DEX prerequisite and cannot remove a DEX contribution that never counted for qualification.
claims.limits: The guide config says DEX14 plus +8 tomes, all level-ups INT; ownership and actual live tome state are not independently established. Manyshot Ranger6 grant explicitly waives prerequisites; IPS Ranger11 grant also waives them, but ordinary selected class routes do not all reach Ranger11. Do not promise feats remain usable after arbitrary base-stat damage, reincarnation, feat swaps, or class changes; none is part of this gear-only request.

claims.claim: The held Calamitous Longbow's retained own page lists ML34, Martial Weapon Proficiency class, required trait None and no racial requirement. Its printed DEX attack/damage modifier is not a minimum-DEX equip requirement and is overridden by the selected Harper mechanics. The held light armor lists ML33, Light Armor Proficiency and Warforged exclusion, with MDB20. The gear-affix swap changes none of these listed requirements.
claims.limits: This is a check of the held bow/armor and selected build, not a blanket claim that every equipment item or feat in DDO lacks continuing conditions.

claims.claim: The selected Horizon Walker Corner the Quarry uses d20+Listen for its marked-target immobilization save; Banish the Quarry uses d20+Listen for banishing extraplanar marked targets. A Wisdom-derived Listen increase improves these DC contributions when applicable.
claims.limits: Boss immunity and target conditions remain. More Wisdom does not turn these into guaranteed control or directly increase their printed weapon/Force damage.

publisher_manual.summary: Wisdom affects Will, Heal, Listen and Spot. Dexterity affects AC and five named DEX skills. The modifier table advances one point per two ability points. Skill checks add the relevant ability modifier. Historical primary; not treated as a current exhaustive rules specification.

data.recommendation: Treat Wisdom in place of gear Dexterity as a defensible utility/Will tradeoff for this preserved INT build, not a free universal upgrade. Preserve DPS-affix safeguards and base/tome/feat selections; report possible lower DEX skills and AC after resolving the full typed stacks. Keep direct gear-only Spot/Will subtotals separate from ability-derived gains. Label +7/+8 Wisdom-derived benefits as conditional on no pre-existing overlapping Enhancement Wisdom source, unchanged other contributions, and the total-score parity.
not_certified: Current player sheet totals and ability parity
Actual endgame AC, effective Dodge or trap-detection thresholds
Total character DPS or a global optimal loadout
